name: Villanueva de Ávila (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes, blue, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de Ávila (a hill above waves on blue and a building on green).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 6 September 1999; the flag is described as a square flag of blue, yellow and green in vertical bands.

features.role: Villanueva de Ávila arms — hill above waves and a building
